documentation.description: File system helpers.  Relative paths always use '/' separators.

subprograms.name: Copy_Tree
subprograms.code:
procedure Copy_Tree
  (From, To : String; Skip_Dirs : String_Vectors.Vector)

documentation.description: Copies the files under From to To, preserving time stamps.
Does nothing when Path does not exist.

subprograms.name: Find_Files
subprograms.code:
function Find_Files
  (Root : String; Skip_Dirs : String_Vectors.Vector)
   return String_Vectors.Vector

documentation.description:
All regular files under Root as sorted relative paths.  Directories
whose relative path matches an entry of Skip_Dirs are not visited.

subprograms.name: Glob_Match
subprograms.code: function Glob_Match (Pattern, Path : String) return Boolean

documentation.description:
"**" matches any sequence including '/', "*" any sequence without
'/', "?" one character other than '/'.  "dir/**" matches everything
under dir.

subprograms.name: Join
subprograms.code: function Join (Dir, Relative : String) return String

subprograms.name: Tail
subprograms.code: function Tail (Path : String; Max_Lines : Positive) return String

documentation.description: Last lines of a text file, or "" when it cannot be read.

Writes Content and makes sure the modification time is at least two
seconds later than the previous one, so time-stamp based builders
(gprbuild) notice the change even when several writes happen within
one second, and on Windows, where GNAT rounds the stamps it records
up to an even second.
